name: NG exhaustion aftermath endpoint confirmation addendum
reason: The first fail-closed validation exposed events whose 3-second nonpositive run starts near +60 but cannot be confirmed until after +60. This addendum resolves onset versus causal knowability without changing the termination signal or tuning to held-out outcomes.

endpoint_semantics.termination_condition: three consecutive causal seconds with oriented trailing-20-second aggressor-volume imbalance <= 0
endpoint_semantics.structural_onset_second: the first second of the first qualifying 3-second run
endpoint_semantics.causal_confirmation_second: the third second of that same qualifying run
endpoint_semantics.descriptive_structural_anchor: structural_onset_second may be retained only as a descriptive cross-check
endpoint_semantics.plus60_role: checkpoint only; it is neither an endpoint nor a censor boundary
endpoint_semantics.asof_plus60_collapsed: true only if the 3-second termination run has been fully confirmed by t0+60; equivalently its onset is at or before t0+58
endpoint_semantics.asof_plus60_alive_or_unconfirmed: true if termination has not yet been causally confirmed by t0+60, including a run that begins at +59 or +60 but is not yet confirmed
endpoint_semantics.censoring: Only lack of a confirmed termination before the end of the available continuous market stream may censor the endpoint. Calendar midnight and daily file boundaries are never censor boundaries.

validation_rule.artifact_zero_s_comparison: Existing zero_s is a structural-onset label inside the bounded +60 artifact. When present it must match reconstructed structural onset exactly. When absent, a reconstructed onset at +59 or later is not drift because confirmation necessarily lies beyond the artifact window.
